blind_target.authors: Uchida, Akitoshi; Michael, Robert B.; Mori, Kazuo
blind_target.title: Scholastic achievement levels and conformity of junior high school students in the Asch experiment
blind_target.evidence_quote: Summarizing, we expect to find a positive association between social approval and conformity (H 4 ), and negative associations for intelligence (H 5 ) and self-esteem (H 6 ).
blind_target.outcome_quote: Finally, we measured the Big Five, intelligence, self-esteem and social approval. With the exception of openness, our study finds no support that these personality traits are statistically significantly related to the susceptibility of group pressure.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Original higher achievement predicted lower conformity; current intelligence association not supported.

blind_target.authors: Kosloff, Spee; Irish, Spencer; Perreault, Leigh; Anderson, Gabrial; Nottbohm, Alexandra
blind_target.title: Assessing relationships between conformity and meta-traits in an Asch-like paradigm
blind_target.evidence_quote: We are particularly interested in the Big Five, intelligence, self-esteem, and the need for social approval.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Finally, we measured the Big Five, intelligence, self-esteem and social approval. With the exception of openness, our study finds no support that these personality traits are statistically significantly related to the susceptibility of group pressure.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Original neuroticism, agreeableness and conscientiousness associations are not supported, while openness, originally null, is associated here.

blind_target.outcome_quote: Replicating previous findings, conditional stimulus valence was not affected by instructed extinction.
